topics.inclusion_rule: Neural BCI studies (intracortical, ECoG, sEEG, EEG, MEG) whose ledger names the recording modality together with a text output, a text error rate or a text-entry rate (characters or words per minute); the design compared is the user action that drives text at use time (attempted handwriting, attempted or overt speech, imagined or inner speech, cursor or keyboard selection, evoked-potential spelling, speech perception). Boundary: a study counts under every action its full text names (upper bound, related-work mentions included); reviews count as pattern matches; versions counted once.

topics.inclusion_rule: Intracortical BCI studies (ledger population: 33 unique studies (46 folders) whose ledger text names an intracortical recording (intracortical, Utah array, microelectrode array) together with cursor, point-and-click, keyboard, typing, text entry, characters per minute, ccpm or grid task); the design compared is the decoder that turns neural activity into text-entry selections: continuous Kalman-family cursor decoder (ReFIT-KF or Kalman filter), discrete click decoder (HMM or LDA state classifier), dwell selection, recurrent-network decoders of characters or words. Boundary: full-text pattern counts with the reference list removed, so related-work mentions and reviews count (upper bound); a study counts under every design it names; the target is included; versions counted once.
